verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a platform that connects agents to external services, so issuing scoped credentials to agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows a way to mint scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. 'Sign in with ChatGPT' only shares basic profile identity and explicitly grants no data access. Connecting an external service is mentioned without any scoping controls, and the community read-only-connection workaround is user-built outside the product.
